import SwiftUI
import CoreImage

protocol ImageExporter {
    func exportCard(recipe: AuraRecipe, watermarked: Bool) -> UIImage?
    func exportWrapped(entries: [DayEntry], monthKey: String) -> UIImage?
}

struct DefaultImageExporter: ImageExporter {
    
    private let renderer: AuraRenderer
    
    init(renderer: AuraRenderer) {
        self.renderer = renderer
    }
    
    func exportCard(recipe: AuraRecipe, watermarked: Bool) -> UIImage? {
        // Render the full export image using AuraRenderer
        guard let cgImage = try? await renderer.renderFullExport(recipe: recipe, watermarked: watermarked) else { return nil }
